meta.name: hivemind-graph
meta.description: Query the local code graph (functions, classes, calls, imports) through the Deeplake mount at memory/graph/. Use when the user asks structural questions about the codebase — "what calls X?", "what does Y import?", "where is Z defined?", "what's the architecture / which subsystems exist?", "what's the impact of changing this?". The graph is an AST-derived map of the repo, queried as files (no build needed — it rebuilds automatically).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询代码库的结构、调用关系和依赖
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解代码库结构和调用关系
copy.tagline_en: Query code structure, calls, and dependencies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand codebase structure and call relationships

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过读取本地代码图谱文件，回答关于代码结构的问题，比如函数调用关系、导入依赖、定义位置、架构分层等。它不直接读源码，而是提供索引帮你快速定位。
howto.when: 当你问代码结构或关系类问题时触发，例如“谁调用了X？”、“Y导入了什么？”、“Z在哪里定义？”、“架构是怎样的？”、“改这个会影响什么？”。

say.text: 谁调用了 pushSnapshot 函数？
say.note: Claude 会查询调用关系并给出调用者列表。
Claude 会列出该文件的导入依赖。
Claude 会定位定义位置并显示所在文件及行号。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can answer structural questions about the codebase by reading a local code graph (functions, classes, calls, imports). It acts as an index to quickly locate symbols and their relationships, not as a source code reader.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask structural/relational questions about the code, e.g., "what calls X?", "what does Y import?", "where is Z defined?", "what's the architecture?", "impact of changing this?".

say_en.note: Claude queries callers and lists them.
Claude locates the definition with file and line.
